raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "receive a warning from"
  role subject "the user"
  role source "the bank"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "be blocked until KYC update"
  role subject "the company account"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?d
  where match
    relation "require usually"
    role subject "the bank"
    role object ?d
    polarity affirmed
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "the documents"
  role object "the ID of the administrator, the updated articles of association and the certificate of incorporation"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
